title: Trigonal and embedded tropical curves of low genus
summary: In algebraic geometry, trigonal curves can always be embedded into Hirzebruch surfaces. In tropical geometry, the notion of trigonality does not have a unique translation. We focus on the characterization in terms of the existence of a degree 3 morphism to a line, and discuss relations to possible embeddings into $\mathbb R^2$ reflecting an embedding into a Hirzebruch surface.
